science_globe.scope: Second homepage fold and approved shared scroll-driven background; original hero first-screen/intro, globe and Enter project preserved
science_globe.geography_source: Read-only copy/derivation of user project tools/globe-source/countries.json
science_globe.rendering: Canvas2D orthographic rotating globe; precomputed local SVG fallback; no new WebGL context
science_globe.visuals: Cream dotted land and fine geographic wireframe; rose Brazil; one continuous viewport-sized hero field travels across both folds; decorative hero lens exits by the second fold.
science_globe.license_note: Country dataset inherited from supplied project; upstream provenance not independently established. No institution logos, affiliations or endorsements.

principle_art.rendering: Authored local inline SVG editorial diagrams; no external imagery, WebGL, decorative bubbles or split-letter monograms
concepts: Currículo / Objetivo / Oportunidades converge into a path
Mentor IA and Ultra human accompaniment remain explicitly distinct
principle_art.motion: Finite line reveals with static readable reduced-motion and no-JS presentation
principle_art.homepage_reel: Removed by user request; local video asset retained for internal/community use
